description:
Create, update, or delete a saved contact. Set `action` to choose the operation.

- create: requires phone_number and name
- update: requires contact_id; only the fields you pass are changed
- delete: requires contact_id, and confirm=true — permanent and cannot be undone. Without confirm the tool deletes nothing and returns a preview of what would be removed, so the user can approve first.

create and update return the saved contact (id, name, phone number, email, notes); delete returns a success flag.

action.description: Which operation to run: create a new contact, update an existing one, or delete one (delete is permanent and needs confirm=true).

confirm.description: Required for action='delete': must be true to actually delete. When false (the default), a delete only previews what would be removed and deletes nothing. Ignored for create and update. Get the user's explicit go-ahead, then call again with the same arguments plus confirm=true.

contact_id.description: ID of the contact to act on, from list_contacts. Required for 'update' and 'delete'.

email.description: An email address to save with the contact.

notes.description: Freeform notes to store with the contact, for your reference.

phone_number.description: The contact's phone number in full international form with country code (e.g. +14155551234). Required for 'create'.

name: manage_contact

outputSchema.description: The saved contact (create/update), a success flag (delete), or a confirmation-required preview.

confirmationRequired.description: True when a delete only previewed (confirm was not true); re-call with confirm=true to delete.

id.description: The contact's unique ID (use as contact_id).

notes.description: Free-text notes about the contact, or null.

success.description: Present on delete: whether it succeeded.

updatedAt.description: When the contact was last updated (ISO 8601).

title: Manage Contact
